title: Gus Grissom's lemon and CIA on the launch pad before his death

tellings.difference: Told by the host with no CIA detail and adds that he died 'the next day' after the lemon.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Gus Grissom's 1967 death on the Cape Kennedy pad and the lemon he hung on the capsule.

plain: Gus Grissom was an American astronaut who died in 1967 on an Apollo launch pad at Cape Kennedy in Florida. A podcast host, Joe Rogan, citing a man named Bart Sibrel and Grissom's wife, says Grissom hung a lemon on a coat hanger outside his spacecraft, complaining that they could not even talk to the control tower, so how would they talk from space. Rogan's version also places the CIA, the US spy agency, on the launch pad. Another host, Jesse Michels, mentions the lemon too and says Grissom died the next day. The story is told as a hint that his death may hide more than an accident.
